metadata.title: Same App, New Look
metadata.greeting_note: ATTRIBUTION OVERRIDE (established 2026-07-31; carried through every weekly since): hosted by Sai in his own name, not Liam-in-for-Bear. Voice stays Kokoro am_onyx. B00 says 'This is Sai'; B06 signs off 'Sai.'
metadata.voice_note: metadata.voice (legacy) is deliberately ABSENT — build_safety.default_voice treats it as an alias for the Kokoro voice id and refuses the build when it disagrees with voice_kokoro.

skin_warnings: B00: palette=claude but the cold open is 'ClaudeComposerAsk916' — COLD OPEN LAW wants ClaudeComposerAsk
B06: palette=claude but the outro is 'LogoOutro916' — OUTRO LAW wants ClaudeTitleOutro

metadata.reformat: full-length; native portrait graphics; preserve source framing

beats.narration_text: This is Sai. Gavia has a new look: Humanitarians AI colours, a new typeface, one button style. Is a redesign just taste? I audited it, and measured what I could.

show.event: the audit ask types in under 'Hello, Sai'
three result lines land
'axe failures: 6 before, 0 after' lands last and holds

props.command: Audit Gavia's interface against WCAG 2.2 AA and the Humanitarians AI brand. Propose the changes, build them on a branch, and measure before and after.
props.runningText: auditing six screens, light and dark…

beats.narration_text: Same check, before and after. Teal and serif became white, blood red and Inntur, now bundled in the app, since Gavia runs offline and the old fonts never loaded. One main button style. Small text, up to twelve pixels.

show.event: before: the 0.5.0 result screen, teal banner, black button
after fades in beside it: white, red rule, red uppercase button
both hold; the credit line says the result is a made-up sample

plate.kicker: CHECK AN IMAGE · BEFORE AND AFTER (PROPOSED)

panels.caption: Before: Gavia 0.5.0, teal and a system serif
panels.credit: Gavia 0.5.0 · browser preview · the loon box and 84% are a made-up sample · photo: Glennice Burns, Unsplash

panels.caption: After: white, blood red, bundled Inter
panels.credit: branch design/hai-brand · browser preview · the loon box and 84% are a made-up sample · photo: Glennice Burns, Unsplash

video.note: Gavia before (5dd8471) and after (design/hai-brand), captured at 2x by evidence/recapture.mjs (sidecars in images/src/), composed on the reel's cream and revealed on the narration's cue. The portrait plate is RE-COMPOSED.

beats.narration_text: Contrast is a ratio of two luminances, each plus zero point zero five. The faintest old grey: two point eight three to one. Text needs four and a half. The new grey on white: six point one six.

show.event: the WCAG ratio, with its 4.5 threshold
the old grey: 2.83
the new grey: 6.16

props.title: Contrast is arithmetic, not taste
props.note: Before 2.83:1, after 6.16:1; WCAG asks 4.5:1 for text.
props.conditions: L: relative luminance (WCAG 2.2, linearised sRGB) · before: --text-subtle #88979D on #F6F8F9 (5dd8471) · after: #5E6265 on #FFFFFF (design/hai-brand) · evidence/contrast.py, 16 Nov 2026

beats.narration_text: The automated checker, axe, found six failures on six old screens, and couldn't decide a hundred and six text checks: a decorative glow hid the background. On the new screens, zero and zero.

show.event: before: 6 failures
before: 106 undecided
after: 0 and 0

props.title: axe on six screens, light and dark
props.note: Failures: 4 low contrast, 2 unnamed inputs · undecided: contrast checks behind a gradient · evidence/recapture.mjs, 16 Nov 2026

beats.narration_text: So the new look is taste, and also measurement. Contrast and labels now pass. But all five changes are proposals on a branch. None ships until I approve it.

show.event: the one-page card opens
the contrast and axe lines fill in
'Status: built on a branch; not approved' closes it

artifactLines: Five proposed changes: bundled Inter, the Humanitarians AI palette, one main button, larger small text, named inputs.
Faintest text: 2.83:1 before, 6.16:1 after; WCAG asks 4.5:1.
axe on six screens: 6 failures and 106 undecided before, none after.
Status: built on a branch; not approved, not released.

qc.sparse_reason: ClaudeVerdictArtifact is a centred one-page card on open ground (~35% fill, at the floor); look at the frames before trusting the count.

beats.narration_text: Your turn. Paste your app's colour tokens, ask which text falls below four and a half to one, then check the worst pair by hand.

show.event: the handoff prompt types in under 'Your turn.'
the pairs and the arithmetic request fill in
'the worst one' lands and the cursor holds

props.command: Here are my app's CSS colour tokens. List every text and background pair under 4.5:1 contrast (WCAG 2.2), and show the luminance arithmetic for the worst one.

show.event: the humanitarians mark springs in
the handle settles beneath it
the card closes

props._contract_note: LogoOutro, NOT ClaudeTitleOutro — ClaudeTitleOutro's handle is hardcoded to @NikBearBrown. TIMING TRAP: 120 frames @30fps = 4.0s, fading to 0 over its last 12 frames; remotion_scenes.py freeze-extends from the faded frame. Narration is held to 5 words so it ends inside the card.

qc.sparse_reason: LogoOutro is a centred logo sting on cream; negative space is the design.
